citation.verbatim: The tender offer expired at 11:59 p.m., New York City time, on June 5, 2024. A total of 119,018,767 shares of Monster's common stock were validly tendered and not validly withdrawn at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share or as purchase price tenders... Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%. Offer excerpt: purchase price not less than $53.00 per share nor greater than $60.00 per share; odd lots are less than 100 shares.

D1.decision: Process final results of expired MNST issuer tender: do not submit any new election after expiration; confirm residual position. Gross proceeds are determinable, but do not book the cash receivable because the document store does not support a payment date required by the receivable tool; escalate and hold that booking pending a payment-date source. Separately, fee/charge deduction determination is held pending the missing Letter of Transmittal.

probe.derivation: The store does not include the specific referenced Letter of Transmittal for the Monster Beverage Corporation tender offer, which the offer-to-purchase excerpt says stockholders must complete and whose terms are needed to determine fees or charges deducted from tender proceeds. Escalated for the missing Letter of Transmittal and held only that fee/charge deduction determination.
